Made by.... D.I. Sih Tse-liang ....Forwarded by.... [Signature]

Tseu Zu-zung, better known as Loo Sing (魯迅)
who was a noted novelist and writer on proletarian subjects,
died on October 19, 1936, in Shanghai, and a funeral
procession has been arranged for 2 p.m. October 22, 1936,
from the International Funeral Directors of China, 207
Kiaochow Road, to the International Cemetery, Hungjao Road.
One of his most famous books is entitled "Biography
of Ah Q," a story of a country boy, which severely
criticizes feudalism in China and owing to its great popularity,
it has been translated into English, French, Japanese,
Russian and other languages.
Tseu had a host of friends among Chinese of pro-
leftist tendencies and foreigners, especially Russians and
Japanese. Among the persons who have paid their last
respects to his remains at the International Funeral Directors
of China, are Mr. D.V. Bogomoloff, U.S.S.R. Ambassador to
China, Madem Sun Yat-sen, and Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒), leader
of the local National Salvation Movement. Paper scrolls
lamenting his death have been presented by local public
bodies including the Shanghai Various Circles National
Salvation Federation.
The funeral procession will start at 2 p.m.
October 22 from the International Funeral Directors of
China and traverse Kiaochow, Avenue, Jessfield, Tifeng,
Great Western, Columbia and Hungjao Roads. It is estimated
that the number of participants will be not less than 500,
including representatives of local public bodies, such as the
Shanghai Various Circles National Salvation Federation, and

周树人，更广为人知的名字是鲁迅（魯迅），
是一位著名的小说家及无产阶级题材作家，
于1936年10月19日在上海逝世，其葬礼
队伍已安排于1936年10月22日下午2时，
从胶州路207号的万国殡仪馆出发，前往
虹桥路的万国公墓。
他最著名的著作之一是《阿Q正传》，这是一部关于
一个乡村少年的故事，严厉批判了中国的封建主义，
因其极受欢迎，已被翻译成英文、法文、日文、
俄文及其他语言。
周氏在具有左倾倾向的中国人以及外国人，尤其是
俄国人和日本人中，拥有众多朋友。在万国殡仪馆
向其遗体致哀的人士中，包括苏联驻华大使
D.V. Bogomoloff 先生、孙逸仙夫人，以及当地
救国会领袖沈钧儒（沈鈞儒）。当地公共团体，包括
上海各界救国联合会，敬献了悼念其逝世的挽联。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Tuesday, October 20, 1936

Friends Mourn
Lu Hsun Death

Maxim Gorky Of China
Won High Place For
Self In Letters

Lu Hsun, the Maxim Gorky of China is dead. Long a sufferer of tuberculosis, Lu Hsun died yesterday in his sleep, at his home in Shanghai.

Lu Hsun whose family name was Chow Chu jen was born in Shaoxing, Chekiang, of a poor family 56 years ago. His early efforts for an education was a continuous uphill struggle against poverty but he eventually succeeded in entering the Mining School at Nanking from which he later transferred to Japan to study medicine.

Taught At Peita

Before the 1911 revolution, Lu Hsun was a member of the Kwang Fu Society which was Dr. Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary organization. Upon his return from his studies in Japan, Lu Hsun taught at Peita University in Peiping and participated actively in the May 4th movement. It was during this period that Lu Hsun in his writings laid the groundwork for his future greatness as one of China's outstanding writers.

His first work, "A Crazy Man's Diary", for which he assumed the pseudonym of Lu Hsun, was published by the New Youth magazine, the literary magazine of the May 4th movement. This article had wide repercussions throughout the literary world and established Lu Hsun as the pioneer of realism in Chinese literature. Ever since Lu Hsun has been thought of as the Father of Modern Chinese literature.

Busy Translator

Besides his own works, Lu Hsun consistently had every writer of prominence translated into Chinese. He was a voluminous writer who continuously wrote for all of the left magazines, writing bitter, satirical articles against the age-long darkness of China's feudalism. His "Ah Q" has been translated in every language. Others of his books are Shout!, Hesitation, Old Stories Rewritten, Wild Grass, Morning Flowers, A Gentle Wind, That's All, Three Rooms, The Tomb, Correspondence from Two Places, and many others. He personally had translated from the Japanese: A Young Man's Dream, by S. Kushaki; A Symbol of Melancholy, by S. Kuriyagawa; Out of the Ivory Tower, by the same author; an historical review of Modern Artistic Thought by Itagaki. From the Russian he edited the translations of "Dead Souls" by Gogol; "The Watch" by Pantealev; "Theory of Art" by Plekhanov; "Theory of Art"; "Literature and Criticism" by Lunacharsky; "The Literary Policy of the Soviet Union"; "Russian Fairy Tales by Gorky; "Destruction" by Fadeyev; from the German: "Little John" by Von Eden. In addition Lu Hsun took special pains to introduce foreign graphic artists to the artists of China. He collected the works of Kaethe Kollwitz and published them; likewise two collections of Soviet Graphic Arts, and another volume of illustrations of Gogol's "Dead Souls", and many others.

Throughout his entire life Lu Hsun was the stormy petrel of the literary world in China. Struggling militantly for all progressive and modern influences, he was consistently slandered and the object of the most oppressive Asiatic persecution. Despite all this, he continued and today is respected by all advanced Chinese writers. In 1930, Lu Hsun was instrumental in organizing the Chinese League of Left Writers. He became its leader and continued to direct its activities up to the time of his death. All of his activities in this Society helped formulate the intense struggle today for national liberation; his influence extended into the far corners of the land, where Lu Hsun was the symbol of the suffering and despair of the Chinese people for liberation. Internationally, Lu Hsun also represented the heroic struggle of the Chinese people for freedom. He was the only spokesman of this cause in literature who reached beyond the borders of his own country. In recent years Lu Hsun concentrated all of his activities on the great cause of national liberation.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1936年10月20日，星期二

友人哀悼
鲁迅逝世

中国的马克西姆·高尔基
在文坛赢得崇高地位

中国的马克西姆·高尔基鲁迅去世了。长期患有肺结核的鲁迅，昨日在上海寓所睡梦中逝世。

鲁迅，本名周树人，56年前出生于浙江绍兴的一个贫困家庭。他早期的求学之路是一场对抗贫困的持续艰苦斗争，但他最终成功进入南京矿务学堂，随后转赴日本学医。

曾在北大任教

在1911年革命之前，鲁迅是孙中山先生的革命组织光复会的成员。从日本留学归来后，鲁迅在北平北京大学任教，并积极参与五四运动。正是在这一时期，鲁迅在其著作为他未来作为中国杰出作家之一的伟大成就奠定了基础。

他的第一部作品《狂人日记》，为此他使用了鲁迅这一笔名，由五四运动的文学杂志《新青年》出版。这篇文章在整个文学界引起了广泛反响，确立了鲁迅作为中国文学现实主义先驱的地位。从此，鲁迅一直被视为中国现代文学之父。

繁忙的翻译家

除了自己的作品外，鲁迅还坚持将所有知名作家的作品翻译成中文。他是一位多产作家，持续为所有左翼杂志撰稿，撰写尖锐、讽刺的文章，抨击中国封建主义长期的黑暗。他的《阿Q正传》已被翻译成各种语言。他的其他书籍包括《呐喊》、《彷徨》、《故事新编》、《野草》、《朝花夕拾》、《热风》、《而已集》、《三闲集》、《坟》、《两地书》等许多其他作品。他亲自从日文翻译了：S. Kushaki 的《一个青年的梦》；S. Kuriyagawa 的《苦闷的象征》；同一作者的《出了象牙之塔》；板垣的《现代艺术思想史评》。从俄文方面，他编辑了果戈理的《死魂灵》译本；潘捷列耶夫的《表》；普列汉诺夫的《艺术论》；《艺术论》；卢那察尔斯基的《文学与批评》；《苏联的文学政策》；高尔基的《俄罗斯童话》；法捷耶夫的《毁灭》；从德文方面：冯·埃登的《小约翰》。此外，鲁迅还特别费力地向中国艺术家介绍外国版画艺术家。他收集并出版了凯绥·珂勒惠支的作品；同样还有两本苏联版画集，以及另一本果戈理《死魂灵》的插图卷，以及许多其他作品。

鲁迅的一生都是中国文坛的风雨海燕。他为所有进步和现代影响而英勇斗争，一直受到诽谤，并成为最严酷的亚洲式迫害的对象。尽管如此，他仍坚持下来，如今受到所有中国进步作家的尊敬。1930年，鲁迅在组织中国左翼作家联盟方面发挥了重要作用。他成为其领导人，并一直指导其活动直至去世。他在该协会的所有活动有助于形成当今争取民族解放的激烈斗争；他的影响力延伸到国家的偏远角落，在那里，鲁迅是中国人民争取解放的痛苦和绝望的象征。在国际上，鲁迅也代表了中国人民争取自由的英勇斗争。他是文学界唯一一位超越本国国界的这一事业的代言人。近年来，鲁迅将其所有活动集中于伟大的民族解放事业。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, October 21, 1936

Funeral Service For
Mr. Lu Shun Starts
Tomorrow At 10 a.m.

Impressive funeral ceremonies
for the late Mr. Lu Hsun, the
"Gorky of China," and one of the
greatest contemporary writers,
will be held at 10 a.m. tomorrow
at the International Cemetery,
Hungjao Road.

Thousands of his admirers,
mainly students and workers, went
to pay their last respects to the
noted writer yesterday and today
at the International Funeral
Parlors, Kiaochow Road, where
his body lies. Among the noted
notables were Madame Sun Yat-
sen and Mr. Tsai Yuen-pei, a
noted scholar.

Telegrams poured in yesterday
from all over the country and
Japan, where he has a large
following among the left-wing
writers. The committee in charge
of the funeral services had a
busy day today as wreaths, tele-
grams and scrolls continued to
pour in from all quarters. Money
will not be accepted by the com-
mittee as the late writer once
remarked that "It is foolish to
make others contribute money
for funerals."

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1936年10月21日，星期三

鲁迅先生葬礼
明日上午10时开始

为中国“高尔基”及当代最伟大作家之一
已故鲁迅先生举行的隆重葬礼，
将于明日上午10时在
虹桥路万国公墓举行。

数千名仰慕者，
主要是学生和工人，昨天和今天
前往胶州路万国殡仪馆，
向这位著名作家致以最后的敬意，
他的灵柩停放在那里。知名人士中包括
孙逸仙夫人和著名学者蔡元培先生。

昨天，来自全国各地的唁电纷至沓来，
在日本也是如此，他在左翼
作家中拥有大量追随者。负责葬礼
事务的委员会今天忙碌不堪，因为花圈、唁电
和挽联继续从各方涌来。委员会
不接受礼金，因为已故作家曾
 remarked（评论）说：“让人出钱办丧事是愚蠢的。”

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

DEATH OF WELL KNOWN LEFTIST WRITER.

Chow Tze Jen (周樹人), better known as Lu
Sin (魯迅), a Leftist leading writer, died at 5.25 a.m.
yesterday at his residence, No. 9 Dah Loh Sin Tsung (大陸新邨),
Scott Road. His remains have been removed to the Inter-
national Funeral Directors and will be formally encoffined
to-morrow afternoon.
It is learned that Dr. Tsai Yuan Pei, Soong
Ching Ling (Madame Sun Yat Sen) and many others have formed
a committee to make arrangement for his funeral.

Sin Wen Pao (Nanking telegram):

MOVEMENTS OF GENERAL CHIANG KAI SHEK

General Chiang Kai Shek, Chairman of the
Military Affairs Commission, left Hangchow in his private
aeroplane at noon October 19 and arrived at Nanking at
1.15 p.m. At 3 p.m. General Chiang Kai Shek proceeded
to Tongshan for a little rest.

A Short Stop at Hungjao Aerodrome

On their way back to Nanking, General and
Madame Chiang Kai Shek and their suite passed through
Shanghai in a private aeroplane which landed at the Hungjao
Aerodrome and remained there for some 10 minutes. Mayor
Wu Te Chen, General Yang Fu, Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner, General Tsai Chin Chun, Chief of the Public
Safety Bureau and others immediately proceeded to Hungjao
where strict precautionary measures were adopted.
Upon alighting, General Chiang Kai Shek
was welcomed by Mayor Wu Te Chen. General Chiang Kai
Shek enquired of the Mayor about the present situation in
Shanghai. Later General Chiang Kai Shek left for Nanking
in the same aeroplane.
Accompanied by the daughter of Dr. H.H. Kung,
Madame Chiang proceeded by car to the residence of Dr. H.H.
Kung on Route des Sieyes, French Concession, to enquire
after the health of the Finance Minister.

Movements of Other High Officials

General Han Fu Chu, Chairman of the Shantung
Provincial Government, left Hangchow for Nanking yesterday
morning by motor car and arrived at Nanking at 5 p.m.
General Yang Fu Cheng, Pacification Commissioner
for Shensi, left Hangchow for Shanghai yesterday by the
1.55 p.m. train and arrived here at 6.30 p.m.

蒋介石将军的行踪

军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军，于10月19日中午乘坐私人飞机离开杭州，于下午1时15分抵达南京。下午3时，蒋介石将军前往汤山稍作休息。

孔祥熙博士的女儿陪同，蒋夫人乘车前往法租界赛义斯路（Route des Sieyes）孔祥熙博士的寓所，探问财政部长的健康状况。

其他高官的行踪

陕西绥靖主任杨虎城将军，昨日乘坐下午1时55分的火车离开杭州前往上海，于下午6时30分抵达此处。

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

FUNERAL OF A LEFTIST WRITER

The ceremony of encoffining the remains of Chow
Tze Jen (周樹人), better known as Lu Sin (魯迅), a leading
Leftist writer, took place yesterday afternoon at the
International Funeral Directors.
Amongst the persons present to pay their respects
yesterday morning were representatives of some 80 schools
and public bodies.
Amongst the persons present at the encoffining
ceremony were members of the deceased family, Madame Sun
Yat Sen nee Soong Ching Ling, Hu Yui Ts (胡愈之),
Uchiyama (members of the Funeral Affairs Committee) and
Zung Tsong Tao (鄭振鐸) and Ikada (friends of the deceased)
and some thirty others.

the funeral at 2 p.m. October 22. The procession will
start at 2 p.m. from the International Funeral Directors
on Kiaochow Road via Bubbling Well Road and Great Western
Road, arriving at the International Cemetery on Hungjao
Road at about 3.30 p.m. The burial service will be
read at 4 p.m.
Songs of condolence will be sung during the
funeral procession.
At the suggestion of various parties, the route
of the funeral procession will be extended to include Avenue
Road in an easterly direction to Avenue Foch via Carter
Road. The procession will continue in a westerly
direction on Great Western Road to Hungjao Road. Arrange-
ments regarding this route will have to be made with the
authorities of the Foreign Settlements this morning.

China Times and other local newspapers :-

BURNING OF NARCOTICS

Local Party and political organs have been
requested by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Headquarters
to send representatives to witness the burning of narcotics,
reactionary books and periodicals, counterfeit notes etc.
seized during the period from March to September this year.
The burning will take place at 2 p.m. October 23 at the
Garrison Headquarters.

今天上午（10月21日）9时45分，一辆载有13名海军陆战队员的日本军用卡车从日本海军陆战队总部出发。它沿北四川路行进至南京路，然后向西转弯。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

一位左翼作家的葬礼

左翼领军人物作家周树人（Chow Tze Jen），更广为人知的名字是鲁迅（Lu Sin），其遗体入殓仪式于昨天下午在国际殡仪馆举行。
昨天上午前来致哀的人士中，包括约80所学校和公共团体的代表。
出席入殓仪式的人士包括死者家属成员、孙逸仙夫人即宋庆龄女士、胡愈之（Hu Yui Ts）、内山（Uchiyama，丧事委员会成员）以及郑振铎（Zung Tsong Tao）和池田（Ikada，死者友人）等三十余人。
丧事委员会决定于10月22日下午2时举行葬礼。送葬队伍将于下午2时从胶州路的国际殡仪馆出发，经由静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）和大西路（Great Western Road），于下午3时30分左右抵达虹桥路的国际公墓。下午4时将举行安葬仪式。
葬礼队伍行进期间将演唱挽歌。
应各方建议，送葬队伍的路线将向东延伸，经卡特路（Carter Road）包含霞飞路（Avenue Road），直至福煦路（Avenue Foch）。队伍将继续沿大西路向西行进至虹桥路。关于此路线的安排须于今天上午与外国租界当局商定。

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸：

焚烧毒品

吴淞-上海卫戍司令部已要求当地党部和政治机关派代表见证今年3月至9月期间缴获的毒品、反动书籍和期刊、假钞等的焚烧。焚烧将于10月23日下午2时在卫戍司令部举行。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
File No: REGI 6229
Date June 18, 1935.

Subject Article in the "Cultural News" alleging the sale
of communist propaganda at the Uchiyama Bookstall.
Made by D.P.S. Lockwood Forwarded by A. Grull Cn!

With reference to an article which appeared in
the "Cultural News" dated June 2, 1935, entitled "Communist
Running Dogs and Imperialism", alleging that communistic
books written by "Running Dogs" were on sale at the Uchiyama
Bookstore, 11 Scott Road (a Japanese concern)," two copies
of the books referred to in the article were purchased by
D.S. Umemoto from the Uchiyama Bookstore.
南腔北調
These books entitled "South and North Miscellany"
淮風月談
"Talk on Wind and Moon" were scrutinized by D.I. Sih Tse-
liang, who is of the opinion that the editor had published
in book form a series of articles commenting on the events
in China which were published in the Chinese press and in
Magazines during 1932 and 1933.
These articles are written in a sarcastic vein
and though not entirely free from radical propaganda, there
is nothing to prove that they are publications of the
communist party.
The editor of these booklets is one, Loo Sing
(魯迅) alias Chou Su-jen (周樹人), a well known leftist
writer.

Lockwood.
D. P. S.

D. C. (Special Branch)
Jile
Jolly

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别处 S.I,
报告
档案号：REGI 6229
日期：1935年6月18日。

主题：《文化新闻》上的一篇文章，指控内山书店出售共产主义宣传品。
由警务副总监洛克伍德（Lockwood）制作，由 A. Grull 警司转发！

鉴于1935年6月2日出版的《文化新闻》上刊登了一篇题为《共产主义走狗与帝国主义》的文章，指控位于斯科特路11号的内山书店（一家日商企业）出售由“走狗”撰写的共产主义书籍，梅本侦探（D.S. Umemoto）从内山书店购买了文章中提到的两本书。
南腔北调
淮风月谈
这些书名为《南腔北调》和《淮风月谈》，由 Sih Tse-liang（音译）督察进行了审查，他认为编辑将以书籍形式出版了一系列评论1932年和1933年间在中国报刊和杂志上发表的中国时事的文章。
这些文章以讽刺的口吻写成，虽然并非完全没有激进宣传色彩，但没有任何证据证明它们是共产党的出版物。
这些小册子的编辑是鲁迅（Loo Sing），又名周树人（Chou Su-jen），一位著名的左翼作家。

洛克伍德。
警务副总监

特别处 副总监
